## Installation

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/purplinator/<repo>.git
cd <repo>
pip install -e .
```

## Quick start

``` python
from lvmtools import fit_cube

result = fit_cube("lvm-SFRAME-00012345.fits", lines=["Halpha", "Hbeta"])
result.write("fits/30dor-lines.fits")
```
